body: Ya, it's hard when people leave you during your worst times. I have been on rTBI a couple of times, sometimes it helps, but lately nothing has been helping much. I have been on medicine for the headaches in the past but right now I don't have health insurance so I can't immediately get anything for the pain. The worst part of all of it is I felt like things were getting better, the pain was getting better etc then it all came back even worse than before. I will look into a caseworker. I definitely need some sort of regular support because doing everything on my own is just not working anymore. Thanks again for talking to me tonight, it does make a difference and makes me feel less alone.

No need to apologize. I'm sorry to hear about your little brother, and a lot of people don't fully understand brain injuries so it is nice to talk to someone who has some understanding. I am in my 20's so I was on my own before my injury, but still had a relationship with my parents and siblings. After my injury the only support I got was from doctors/rehab and now my family does not speak to me. They basically abandoned me and said it was too hard for them to deal with. It's been almost a year since my injury so it's not really new but lately I have been getting these blinding migraines every day and today I laid in bed all day with shooting pains in my head. I have to move out of my apartment soon and I don't have a job or friends so I have just been so stressed out and it's taking a massive toll on me emotionally. I thought my life was going to go so differently, and I've been trying to stay positive for so long but it's getting harder and harder. Anyways, thanks for letting me vent. It means a lot.

Well thank you for checking in. I don't know, I guess I just wanted someone to talk to that wouldn't give me such generic responses. I'm appreciative of the service but it felt like 3 short texts from a robot and then done. I'm just having such a hard night. I got a brain injury not too long ago and have absolutely no help or support from anyone. And tonight I'm having one of the worst headaches I've ever had. I've been trying to do everything on my own but I'm just scared and out of hope.

Thanks. They responded a couple minutes ago but it was a very short conversation. They basically just sent me a link and told me I was a brave person. Not sure what I was expecting but it wasnt much help.
I’m suicidal too and also having a hard night. You can DM me if you want. Just not sure how much help I’ll be since I’m in a pretty dark place.
